PullRequest.Title: Rename Ensemble Intelligence to High and update tier descriptions
PullRequest.Body:

Follow-up to #340896 and #340937. Updates the Ensemble model picker labels and descriptions. Regular Auto is unchanged.

Scenarios.Scenario: Copilot model catalog refresh and Ensemble schema publication
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The pre-existing SDK model-list RPC must finish before a fresh catalog can be published. The changed code then synchronously maps the single Auto model's retained tiers to labels; this bounded transformation is on the publication path but adds no wait or boundary.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: List models through the Copilot SDK subprocess via client.rpc.models.list, with the SDK handling its remote catalog access.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One RPC per effective refresh attempt, independent of model or tier count; concurrent refresh requests are coalesced and failures use existing bounded retry scheduling.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same RPC and refresh cadence occurred before the diff; only the in-memory label selected while publishing Ensemble changed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The RPC is required before a newly fetched catalog is published; the changed label mapping executes only after it returns.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Catalog size controls the existing publication map, but the changed work applies only to the Auto entry and at most the three fixed Auto tiers (two after Ensemble filters Efficiency).
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Periodic and lifecycle refreshes coalesce onto one in-flight refresh; scheduled invalidations coalesce on the next task, and retries are sequenced by the existing generation/backoff logic.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The last known good CAPI catalog is retained on failures, BYOK enumeration is read from an existing registry cache, and repeated refresh requests share the in-flight promise. The diff changes neither cold catalog discovery nor warm-cache behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the call path, one-RPC refresh behavior, coalescing, and fixed tier cardinality are explicit in the inspected code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Runtime catalog size and RPC duration vary, but they do not change the added work's fixed upper bound or boundary count.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff adds only bounded string selection/localization and a two-element label array for the single Auto model; it neither increases RPC frequency nor scales with catalog size beyond pre-existing publication work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Opening, refreshing, and selecting tiers in Ensemble model details
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Opening details synchronously obtains or reuses a ModelCard, builds routing-alternative options, refreshes the card DOM, and shows it. The changed branch computes one localized description for each available HydraFusion routing alternative before rendering.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Open the existing HydraFusion learn-more HTTPS URI after an explicit user click.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Zero during card construction/rendering and at most one opener action per explicit Learn more activation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Each routing alternative already carried the same learn-more URL before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Off the picker rendering and selection critical paths; only an explicit link activation reaches the opener.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The routing-alternative input is fixed by COPILOT_HYDRA_FUSION_MODEL_NAMES to at most HydraFusion and HydraFusion Max, so the changed description logic runs at most twice per card option rebuild.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: This is synchronous UI work on the interaction path; selection and refresh callbacks run serially on the UI thread. There is no added queue, fan-out, or asynchronous creation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: ModelCard instances are reused from _cards by model/speed-variant key and updated in place. The diff does not change cache keys, lifetime, invalidation, or cold versus warm behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: model-card caching, synchronous render path, and the two-model bound are explicit.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual DOM render duration depends on the rest of the card, but the changed work remains two bounded string branches and replaces an equal or greater number of prior localize calls.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The changed descriptions do not increase routing-alternative cardinality, DOM ownership, or boundary calls, and for Ensemble they omit the prior tooltip localization.

Scenarios.Scenario: Formatting Ensemble response details and model-picker readouts
Scenarios.CriticalPath: At response-detail formatting or readout construction, getEnsembleTierLabel scans the small configuration-property object and reads the Intelligence label; the changed fallback returns High instead of Intelligence.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One helper invocation per relevant response/readout, over the configuration properties of one Auto model; the diff does not alter invocation count or property scan size.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Formatting is synchronous and local to each response/UI update; no parallel boundary operations are launched.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The helper reads already-published in-memory model metadata. No cache is added, removed, bypassed, or invalidated by the diff.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: all callers and the unchanged metadata scan were inspected; only the selected localization helper differs.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Response frequency varies by usage, but changed cost is equivalent to the prior localized-label fallback on each invocation.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The fallback localization has the same constant-time shape and allocation profile as before.

Scenarios.Scenario: Workbench startup configuration registration and on-demand chat accessibility help
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Configuration descriptions are localized while registering static settings at startup, while accessibility help text is assembled only when its provider is requested. The diff substitutes string contents without adding operations.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Fixed numbers of schema properties and help paragraphs; no user collection or history controls the changed work.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Both paths are synchronous local string construction with no new scheduling or fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Static configuration schemas retain the same lifecycle, and accessibility help builds one text value per help-provider request as before. No cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed hunks are literal substitutions in existing localization calls.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Localization implementation cost is not measured, but call count and lifecycle are unchanged and only literals differ.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Startup and accessibility-help work have unchanged cardinality, boundaries, and lifecycle.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 10 changed files and all diff pages. Traced model refresh/publication, picker rendering and card reuse, response/readout formatting, startup registration, and accessibility help. The PR changes bounded labels/descriptions only; it adds no scaling work, retained lifecycle, concurrency burst, or expensive boundary, so no findings were submitted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
